question: R4 cap-tilt lift (momentum EW top-25 port_t 1.277 -> size_prop_cap 2.100, [0,0.20] cap): (i) regime mega-beta directional bet, (ii) signal-agnostic construction default worth transplanting as book/optimizer/RAMP base weighting, or (iii) robust alpha?

answer_captilt_nature.verdict: REGIME-CONDITIONAL MOMENTUM x LARGE-CAP INTERACTION (i, not ii, not robust alpha)
answer_captilt_nature.detail: Two independent lanes converge and jointly reject both the signal-agnostic-default hypothesis and the robust-alpha hypothesis. The lift is real economics but conditional on (a) the momentum signal specifically and (b) the 2020+ mega/semiconductor regime.

lane1_regime_beta_attribution.reading: Lift loads +0.461 (t=3.81) on large-minus-small: removing EW's benchmark-relative small-cap overweight = taking on size beta. Lift realized entirely in 2020-2026 (+12.2%/yr, t=1.53); same cap-tilt HURT pre-2017 (-3.2%/yr, t=-1.66) when size premium favored small caps (-20.5%/yr). The port_t=2.25 residual alpha of cap-tilt active belongs to the shared underlying momentum signal (pre2017 alpha, 2017+ decayed), NOT to the weighting lift.

lane2_signal_agnostic_captilt.decisive_falsifier: random_null delta = -0.247 (NEGATIVE). A pure mega-beta construction default would lift random selection too; it does not. So the R4 lift is NOT a signal-free WEIGHT artifact ('remove EW small-cap penalty') but a momentum x large-cap interaction (recent winners concentrate in large caps in the KR mega/tech regime).
lane2_signal_agnostic_captilt.value_opposite: value delta = -0.800 (large-value = value trap / benchmark hugging destroys it).
lane2_signal_agnostic_captilt.lag1_stress: no leak across all 8 signals (momentum capw 1.527->1.454).

deploy_recommendation.rationale: Signal-agnostic transplant is falsified: 6/8 signals (incl. random-null -0.247, value -0.800, low_vol -0.370, dividend -0.440) LOSE under cap-tilt; only momentum gains (+1.019), composite/size ~0. A global default weighting would inject size beta and hurt in pre-2017 / small-cap-favoring regimes. Standalone capital graduation also FAILS (cap-tilt momentum capw port_t 1.527 and even R4 2.100 both < HARD 2.95; oos_retention 0.374 < 0.7; lift front-loaded to 2020+).
deploy_recommendation.allowed_route: Momentum-sleeve-specific large-cap reweight ONLY, consumed as a beta-budget / regime-overlay exposure (large-cap-momentum tilt), NOT as new standalone alpha and NOT as a universal base weighting. Book-marginal ΔIR must be measured before any admission (governor manual, per §4).

overnight_arc_R1_R5_one_line: R1-R5 arc: the momentum transition wall (IC->PORT_t) is a WEIGHT-basis phenomenon, but the cure is neither free nor general — EW->cap-tilt recovers ~0.8 port_t only for momentum and only in the 2020+ large-cap regime (loads +0.46 on size beta, hurts pre-2017 and every non-momentum signal incl. random-null), so it is a regime-conditional momentum x large-cap bet routable to beta-budget/overlay, not a signal-agnostic construction default and not standalone capital-grade alpha (< HARD 2.95).
next_probes: Cap-tier decompose the momentum top-25 into MEGA/MID/small buckets and attribute the lift by tier (per project-captier-alpha-localization): confirm lift lives in the MEGA tier and quantify how much survives if the mega tier is capped, to separate 'large-cap-momentum alpha' from 'benchmark-hugging beta'.

Route cap-tilt momentum as a beta-budget / regime-overlay exposure onto the incumbent PG2 book and measure book-marginal ΔIR (net-active recon basis, §4) with |corr|<0.30 gate — standalone HARD is missed so the only viable consumer surface is marginal contribution, not admission.

Regime-gate the cap-tilt: apply the large-cap reweight only in large-cap-favoring months (LMS>0 or a PIT large-minus-small momentum-of-size proxy) and measure whether conditional application lifts full-period oos_retention above 0.7, testing whether the front-loaded lift is harvestable out-of-sample or is a look-back regime artifact.

Test intermediate weightings (sqrt-size, capped-linear at [0,0.10] vs [0,0.20], inverse-vol) on the momentum sleeve to find whether a milder size tilt captures most of the lift with less regime/size-beta exposure (dose-response of the size-beta bet vs the momentum-concentration effect).
consumer_surfaces: beta-budget / regime-overlay: large-cap-momentum tilt as an exposure, NOT standalone alpha (primary viable surface given HARD miss)
momentum sleeve weighting (sleeve-local): size_prop_cap reweight applied only to momentum selection, gated on cap-tier attribution
monitoring tripwire: LMS (large-minus-small) sign + corr(lift,LMS) as a regime indicator — cap-tilt lift is a mega-regime coincident signal

FQ etiquette / frontier queue: register 'signal-agnostic cap-tilt default' as FALSIFIED (do not re-propose global base-weighting transplant); register 'cap-tier lift attribution + regime-gated cap-tilt' as open frontier
NOT ROUTED (falsified): optimizer / RAMP / book universal default base weighting — random-null/value/low_vol/dividend all lose under cap-tilt

handoff_to_dohoon.summary: R4 발견(동일 momentum 25종목을 Size 비례 재가중 size_prop_cap, [0,0.20] cap만으로 EW port_t 1.277->2.100)의 본질을 R5 2-lane으로 규명. Lane1(β-귀속): 이 lift는 large-minus-small에 +0.461(t=3.81) 유의 로딩 = size-beta 노출이고, 실현 전량이 2020-2026 mega/반도체 레짐 집중(+12.2%/yr, t=1.53)이며 pre-2017엔 오히려 HURT(-3.2%/yr, t=-1.66). lift 잔차α는 t=1.40으로 비유의(cap-tilt active의 port_t 2.25 잔차α는 lift가 아니라 밑깔린 momentum 신호). Lane2(신호-불문): 8개 선택신호 중 momentum만 Δ=+1.019 양수, ★random-null Δ=-0.247 음수 → 순수 mega-beta construction default 반증. value -0.800, low_vol/dividend도 손해. 즉 signal-agnostic 기본가중 이식가치 아님.
handoff_to_dohoon.verdict: cap-tilt lift = regime-conditional momentum x large-cap 상호작용 (mega-beta 방향베팅). robust alpha 아님, signal-agnostic 기본가중 아님.
handoff_to_dohoon.deploy_recommendation: EW->cap-tilt를 optimizer/RAMP/book 전역 기본가중으로 이식 = NO (6/8 신호서 손해). momentum sleeve 한정 large-cap 재가중 or β-예산/overlay 노출로만 라우팅. standalone 자본졸업 미달(capw 1.527·R4 2.100 둘 다 < HARD 2.95, oos 0.374 < 0.7).
handoff_to_dohoon.honesty_flags: front-loaded(pre2020 t 1.95 vs 2020+ 0.99, 본 R5 재현) + oos_retention 0.374 + random-null lift 음수 = 전부 mega-beta 방향 증거. 과대해석 금지 — 신규 알파 생성 아님.
